name: DomainCanary
description: Official hosted server for DomainCanary, a DMARC service. Checks a domain's live DMARC, SPF and DKIM records and says what to fix, builds one SPF record from a list of senders with its DNS lookup count, explains a bounce or SMTP reply such as 550 5.7.26, and reads a DMARC aggregate report. No account or API key needed.
author: DomainCanary
